rules.statement: The appointment of an attorney to act in Ceylon does not remove the disability constituted by absence beyond the seas under section 14 of Ordinance No. 22 of 1871.
rules.supporting_quote: "I can conceive of only one way by which absence from a place is terminated, namely, by going to that place. It can scarcely be argued that the right to sue for the recovery of the property first accrued to the attorney on his appointment in 1894."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 14 of Ordinance No. 22 of 1871, s. 14.
